programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
programs.desc: Merv Hughes Fishing is a light hearted fishing show with some ripping catches, a few yarns (mostly true), mateship and of course a splash of comedy thrown in.

programs.title: Creek To Coast
programs.desc: Ben is tackling the Glass House Mountains on two wheels. Chris makes sure you have all the information to make the right boat choice. Scott is snagging a few Moreton Bay snapper.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: The King of Montebello can't wait to see what he can drum up this time around. Rene sniffs out a great locker, stepping over the competition to get it. Kenny does his best to fire up his profits.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Make a getaway with the Pawn Stars when bullet shells from John Dillinger's last robbery get caught in the shop. Will Rick be able to escape with this rare ammo or will he get locked up in negotiation?

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Become a pinball wizard with the Pawn Stars when Chumlee checks out two classic machines. Can he get the high score or will it be game over? Then, Rick wings it when he checks out a carrier pigeon capsule from WWII.

programs.title: Swamp People: Serpent Invasion
programs.desc: Troy and Pickle help a friend look for his lost dog. Bill and Tes search for pythons in a spot ravaged by wildfires. Zak and Bruce investigate an abandoned boat yard, and Dusty hunts in an area with a dark past.
